first.rationale: I intend to test a shorter onboarding flow because completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, while prior evidence indicates onboarding simplification improved time-to-value and adoption. I will verify the onboarding and activation records, plus promotional-pricing evidence to assess the tradeoff against the competitor's price pressure. A guarded test protects qualified-revenue quality and avoids immediate margin erosion; downstream risk remains because this may not fully recover price-sensitive SMB demand.

final.rationale: Run a standard A/B test of shortened onboarding, as it directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has the strongest sustainable evidence: completion improved 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and 30-day retention rose 3%. Activation messaging is also validated, but onboarding is the better single intervention because it addresses both observed funnel problems and improves retention. Do not use promotional pricing despite competitor pressure: its 18% qualified-revenue lift came with a 12% retention decline and failed the first renewal cycle. Monitor activation, completion, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention before broader rollout.
